metadata.design: Atomic machine-readable rules for deterministic eligibility evaluation. Do not use LLM inference as final eligibility authority.
metadata.verification_policy: Only rules with current evidence are treated as evaluable. Rules marked requires_clause_extraction/current-source capture are evidence gates, not numeric assumptions.
metadata.important: Application availability and selection outcomes are separate from eligibility.
